title: From overwhelmed to underwhelmed…
text:
From overwhelmed to underwhelmed…. [[VIDEOID:d3883e9d223ef76abb5070976d922043]] The best feature is being able to set the room temperature digitally. This is a small unit like many out there in the category. I was thinking this would be a step above the average, but it just seems average. There is some rattling noise with the metal with mine. It kicks out a lot of heat, but so do many others within the 1,500w setting. I was expecting the design to be better for the higher asking price.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Space Heaters for Indoor Use, 1500W Electric Heater for Large Room, Electric Ceramic Heater with Remote, Thermostat, Tip-Over & Overheat Protection, Portable Heaters for indoor use, Office, Home…
features: Featuring with advanced PTC ceramic heating element, this electric space heater could efficiently warm you up in seconds and keeps you away from chill. Personalize your warmth with 2 heating modes (High:1500W, Low:100W) and fan only setting. Perfect solution for those who want direct, personal warmth on cold days.

The heaters for indoor use equips with large touch-screen control panel with LED display on the top, providing super easy and convenient usage experience. The full functional remote control allows to adjust settings without getting out of your bed. Comes with 12H timer, it will auto power off when the desired time is finished.

With built-in overheat protection feature, this indoor space heater would auto power off when it detect the components overheated to avoid fire hazard. The tip-over safety function will also shut the heater off if it knocked over by accident. ETL listed.

The easy-to-carry handle at the top helps you carry around wherever you want to warm up. Designed in portable size 20 in (H) * 7 in (W), this portable tower heater is super perfect for personal use and doesn't take up much space, simply place it at your feet, on the floor or next to your bed to warm your hands and feet.

Featuring with 60° widespread oscillation, this electric room heater could auto oscillating from side to side for wide heating range, helps you create a comfortable warm zone and sharing warmth with your families and friends. The adjustable temp range from 50℉ to 95℉, 2 separated temp control buttons to customize your preferred warmth.
